R000576.name: Dutch Ruppersberger
R000576.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative for Maryland's 2nd district from 2003 to 2025. He was Baltimore County Executive before Congress.

R000606.name: Jamie Raskin
R000606.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative for Maryland's 8th district since 2017. Before Congress he was a constitutional law professor and a Maryland state senator.
